signatures.description: Given an unordered set of zone files plus delegation and glue records, build the zone-cut graph and resolve CNAME chains entirely offline, detecting loops, chains exceeding the 16-query limit, DNAME synthesis that pushes a synthesized name past the 255-octet limit, and delegations whose glue sits outside the delegating zone (bailiwick violations). Emit a deterministic sorted finding list with the shortest reference path for each finding, using only bash/awk/jq and no network access.
